decisions.rationale: SEC terms establish USD 103.75 per legacy DPS share, continuation of one public-company share as KDP, due-bill timing through July 9, and reinvestment in KDP when trading resumed July 10. The V002 cash-plus-continuing-share wealth factor therefore represents the shareholder entitlement.

NortonLifeLock declared a one-time USD 12 cash dividend on every outstanding common share, payable January 31 with an explicit February 3 ex-dividend date. Common shares continued after the distribution, so cash plus the continuing share is the complete common-stock entitlement.

Franklin Resources officially records a USD 3.00 special cash dividend and USD 0.23 regular dividend with the same March 29 record date. Their USD 3.23 total matches the provider-native distribution while the BEN common share continues unchanged.

TransDigm's filed 2017 annual report identifies the USD 22 special cash dividend on each outstanding common share, with September 5 record and September 12 payment dates. No common-share exchange accompanied the distribution.

TransDigm's Form 8-K and official release declare a one-time USD 90 cash dividend on each outstanding common share, record date September 2 and payment September 12, 2025. The common share continues unchanged.

Progressive officially declares a USD 13.50 annual common dividend plus a USD 0.10 quarterly dividend, both for holders of record January 2, 2026. The USD 13.60 aggregate matches V002 and does not alter the common share.

Ford filings identify a USD 0.65 supplemental dividend and USD 0.15 regular dividend per Common and Class B share in first-quarter 2023. Their USD 0.80 aggregate matches V002 and the shares continue after payment.

TransDigm's official release and annual filing identify a USD 30 special cash dividend on each outstanding common share, record date August 16 and payment August 23, 2019. No share exchange accompanied it.

LyondellBasell filings record a USD 5.20 special dividend and USD 1.19 quarterly dividend for the same June 6 record date. Their USD 6.39 aggregate matches V002 and ordinary shares continue unchanged.

TransDigm's official filed release declares a USD 32.50 special cash dividend on every outstanding common share, record date December 30, 2019 and payment January 7, 2020. The common share remains outstanding.

TransDigm's official release and Form 8-K declare a USD 75 special cash dividend on each outstanding common share, record date October 4 and payment October 18, 2024. No share conversion accompanies the distribution.
